source.workbook: World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide, Issue 54 (Q3 2025)

policy.ranking: Providers are ranked by total cost exactly as published — ascending, never clamped or excluded (ADR-0007).
policy.negative_margin: A negative FX margin means the provider's exchange rate beats the World Bank's reference rate, so cost measured against the official rate falls below zero. The printed fee is still positive. Shown as a 'rate advantage' flag, never hidden.
policy.non_transparent: Quotes whose FX margin is not disclosed are never ranked; they are listed separately with a flag (the published total is kept).
